text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Narita Top Road,
we stopped by a sports café at her suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
A classmate recommended this place to me.
They said it's mainly for watching soccer matches.
choice_data_list: This shop has such a nice atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: You're right. Ah, looks like the broadcast is starting. Let's order some drinks.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Corner kick—into a shot!
But what a shame! Deflected by the keeper!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, Trainer, did you see that?
That was so close just now, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what's gonna happen in the second half.
It's tied right now,
so I'm on the edge of my seat!
choice_data_list: You look like you're having fun, Top Road.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes! Because I love soccer!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It started out as a way to build up stamina,
but now, I enjoy both doing it and watching it!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Number 9 is surrounded and in a tight spot!
Even so, she dodges, she dodges with a brilliant dribble!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was amazing, the way you broke through just now!
It's like you grew wings...!
choice_data_list: This'll be a good reference for when I get blocked!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You might be right!
In that case, let's observe very carefully!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing watching soccer, we step out of the cafe.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's pretty crowded.
I wonder if there was some kind of event?
choice_data_list: Gotta be careful not to get separated.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, excuse me!
I'm trying to get through over there... Wah-oof?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Aaah~... It's going further and further in reverse—
Not that way~...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Waaah, Traaaineer~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I rescued Narita Top Road after she got swept up in the crowd, and we took temporary shelter in a nearby alley.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...
I couldn't go against the flow of the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "If only there were some trick to slipping through crowds, though..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Those words reminded me of an ace striker breaking through a chaotic battle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cast your gaze a bit farther ahead and keep a wide field of view.
I suggested that doing so might make it easier to anticipate people's movements
and take evasive action...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I see. That number 9 player wasn't looking at the ball, but off into the distance!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I'll give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Cast your gaze far ahead, and be mindful of your surroundings—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, looks like someone's coming from the other side!
I'll step aside to the left while I can—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
! Over there, the crowd is thinning out.
If we can make it over, we won't get swept away!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yay~!
We somehow pulled through!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
As you can see, I'm feeling completely fine!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I've gotten the hang of it, so
running into crowds again won't be a problem!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...I think we might be able to apply this to a lot more things...
Like races, and various other areas too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It was truly a wonderful experience!
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Watching the soccer match was a great learning experience!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to go to that café with me again?
I'm sure there's still so much more we can learn!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much!
I'm looking forward to next time!
